description: The picture of a content (DESIGN.md, Thumbnail): ThumbnailRatio.square by default, ThumbnailRatio.portrait or ThumbnailRatio.wide, with a radius that grows with size. A TsuyaColors.fill placeholder, with an optional placeholder icon, shows while image loads, fails, or is null. Decorative unless it has label. image is decoded at the thumbnail's own display size.

constructors.description: A thumbnail of image, size wide.

params.name: image
params.description: The picture; the placeholder shows while it is null, loading or failed.

params.name: size
params.description: Its width, in px; the height follows from ratio. Default 48.

params.name: label
params.description: The accessible name; decorative when left out.
